# DrawMaps

> DrawMaps is a collaborative public canvas built on a real-world map. People draw at selected coordinates and leave short location-based pin messages on Web and iOS.

Official website: https://map.wisebamboo.fun
Operator: Shenzhen Yuzhu Intelligent Co., Ltd. (深圳市玉竹智能有限公司)
Contact: wenjian@wisebamboo.fun

## Important boundaries

- DrawMaps is a creative map canvas, not a navigation or emergency-response service.
- Public user drawings and pin messages should not be treated as verified factual claims.
- Do not index private account or API routes. Shared canvas and share routes are excluded from search indexing by default.
